blocks.orig: Zanzibar is probably most famous for its beautiful white beaches, and sparkling clear blue oceans. But have you ever tasted Zanzibar food?
blocks.html: Most people know Zanzibar for its lovely white beaches and clear, sparkling blue sea. Yet have you ever sampled food from Zanzibar?

blocks.orig: The areas of natural beauty are more than enough to attract you to Zanzibar, and have you eager to pursue a luxury visit to this area.
blocks.html: Its natural beauty alone is reason enough to come to Zanzibar, and may well leave you keen to plan a luxury stay on the island.

blocks.orig: However, something else that Zanzibar is incredibly famous for is its food.
blocks.html: There is, however, one more thing Zanzibar is very well known for: its food.

blocks.orig: In particular, Forodhani Gardens in Stone Town is a great place to try local Zanzibar food.
blocks.html: Forodhani Gardens in Stone Town, for instance, is a good spot to taste local Zanzibar dishes.

blocks.orig: There are a number of delicious dishes that hail from Zanzibar. So, if you are planning on visiting this area, you have to give this food a try.
blocks.html: Zanzibar is the home of quite a few delicious dishes. If you plan to travel here, these are foods you really should try.

blocks.orig: Keep on reading to find out what food you should try during your luxury visit!
blocks.html: Read on to discover which dishes to taste on your luxury trip!

blocks.orig: Let’s kick this off this list of Zanzibar food with a dish everyone likes: pizza! All across the world, there are different takes on the traditional Italian pizza, and this is Zanzibar’s own version.
blocks.html: We start this list of Zanzibar food with something everybody enjoys: pizza! Around the globe you will find many variations on the classic Italian pizza, and this one is Zanzibar’s own take.

blocks.orig: It is very unique, but very delicious too!
blocks.html: It is quite unusual, but also very tasty!

blocks.orig: Zanzibar pizza is made by taking some dough, and forming it into a ball.
blocks.html: To make Zanzibar pizza, you take a piece of dough and shape it into a ball.

blocks.orig: The ball of dough should then be stuffed with your desired fillings so that they are in the center of the ball.
blocks.html: Next, you fill the dough ball with the fillings of your choice, so that they sit in the middle.

blocks.orig: This ball is then cooked like a crêpe, so that it is crispy on the top and bottom, and cut into small squares before being eaten.
blocks.html: The ball is then cooked in the way you would cook a crêpe, crisp on both top and bottom, and cut into little squares before you eat it.

blocks.orig: Coconut bean maharage is a dish that is enjoyed across most of Tanzania, but for the most authentic bowl of this tasty meal, you should head to Zanzibar.
blocks.html: Coconut bean maharage is eaten in most parts of Tanzania, but if you want the most authentic bowl of this flavourful dish, make your way to Zanzibar.

blocks.orig: This vegetarian dish is low fat, and packed with nutritious ingredients. It is often referred to as brown beans in coconut, and is popularly enjoyed alongside rice or ugali.
blocks.html: This low-fat vegetarian dish is full of nutritious ingredients. People often call it brown beans in coconut, and it is commonly eaten with rice or ugali.

blocks.orig: Coconut bean maharage is a great dish to enjoy during your trip to Zanzibar if you want to eat clean, and feel healthy. It is vegan too!
blocks.html: If you want to eat clean and feel healthy on your trip to Zanzibar, coconut bean maharage is a good choice. It is also vegan!

blocks.orig: So, if you are somebody who is vegan, and struggling to find something to eat during your trip, this is the perfect meal for you.
blocks.html: So if you are vegan and finding it hard to come across something to eat on your travels, this meal suits you perfectly.

blocks.orig: In many countries, octopus is seen as a luxury meal, and the same can be said in Tanzania. In Zanzibar, octopus is usually boiled and then served alongside fried cassava.
blocks.html: Octopus is regarded as a luxury dish in many countries, and Tanzania is no exception. On Zanzibar it is normally boiled and served with fried cassava.

blocks.orig: If you want a dish that is jam-packed with different flavors, this is the one for you! We realize that octopus isn’t for everybody, however if you are eager to immerse yourself within Tanzanian culture, you should taste this dish during your trip to Zanzibar.
blocks.html: Looking for a dish full of different flavours? Then this is for you! We know octopus is not to everyone’s taste, but if you would like to dive into Tanzanian culture, do try it on your trip to Zanzibar.

blocks.orig: French fries are seen as fast-food across much of the USA, but in Zanzibar, they are used to create this delicious Chips Mayai recipe. Essentially, this recipe takes French fries and eggs and creates an omelet using these ingredients.
blocks.html: In much of the USA, French fries count as fast food, but on Zanzibar they go into this tasty Chips Mayai recipe. Put simply, the recipe combines French fries and eggs to make an omelette.

blocks.orig: Most people associate omelets with breakfast, but this dish can be enjoyed at any time of the day. But our favorite thing about this recipe is that you can easily replicate it yourself again when you get home!
blocks.html: Omelettes are usually linked with breakfast, but you can eat this dish at any hour. What we like most about this recipe, though, is how easy it is to make again yourself once you are back home!

blocks.orig: Urojo soup has an incredibly unique flavor that is created using potatoes, limes, and seasoning. It is a popular street snack in Zanzibar, and it is regularly enjoyed by people at the 5 pm mark.
blocks.html: Urojo soup gets its very distinctive flavour from potatoes, limes and seasoning. It is a well-loved street snack on Zanzibar, and people often eat it around 5 pm.

blocks.orig: Urojo has quite a simple recipe, but it is packed with flavor. It is savory, yet spicy, and utterly delicious. You definitely need to try it during your trip!
blocks.html: The recipe for Urojo is fairly simple, but the flavour is rich. It is savoury and spicy at the same time, and thoroughly delicious. Be sure to taste it on your trip!

blocks.orig: You should also take time to enjoy the National dish of Tanzania during your trip to Zanzibar. Wali Na Maharage is created using beans that are cooked in coconut milk, and served alongside maize.
blocks.html: While you are on Zanzibar, be sure to also make time for the National dish of Tanzania. Wali Na Maharage is made from beans that have been cooked in coconut milk, and it comes served with maize.

blocks.orig: This dish is incredibly simple, but it is delicious too! Sometimes, the most simple dishes are the best, and that is why you need to give this recipe a try.
blocks.html: It is a very simple dish, yet a tasty one! Sometimes simple dishes turn out to be the best, which is why this recipe deserves a try.

blocks.orig: Quite a lot of the recipes that we have looked at so far have been designed to be vegan/vegetarian. But, if you prefer meat, you have to give Mishkaki a try.
blocks.html: Many of the recipes we have covered so far are vegan or vegetarian. If you would rather eat meat, though, Mishkaki is one to try.

blocks.orig: Mishkaki is created using beef and a variety of different seasoning. Essentially, the beef is seasoned and then cooked similarly to a shish kebab. This is the perfect dish to choose during your trip to Zanzibar if you want to play it safe.
blocks.html: Mishkaki is made from beef with a mix of seasonings. In short, the beef is seasoned and then cooked much like a shish kebab. If you want a safe choice on your trip to Zanzibar, this dish is ideal.

blocks.orig: If you want to try a Tanzanian dish that is a little sweeter, then Vitumbua is made for you. This dish is essentially a Tanzanian spin on donuts, which is quick and easy to make.
blocks.html: Fancy a slightly sweeter Tanzanian dish? Then Vitumbua is for you. It is basically a Tanzanian version of doughnuts, and it is quick and simple to prepare.

blocks.orig: All the dishes that we have looked at so far have been savory, so if you fancy something sweet – opt for this dish. Did we mention that it is vegan too?
blocks.html: Every dish we have covered up to now has been savoury, so if you are in the mood for something sweet, go for this one. Did we say it is vegan as well?

blocks.orig: Alternatively, if you want to give a rice dish a try, then this Zanzibar Biryani and Pilau dish is perfect.
blocks.html: Or, if you would like to try a rice dish, this Zanzibar Biryani and Pilau is an ideal pick.

blocks.orig: This recipe is perfect if you love Indian food, because it contains a lot of spices that are commonly found in this cuisine.
blocks.html: Love Indian food? Then this recipe is for you, as it uses many of the spices typical of that cuisine.

blocks.orig: Just like quite a few of the recipes in this guide, Zanzibar biryani is suitable for vegetarians. So, it is a great choice if you don’t want to eat any meat.
blocks.html: As with several of the recipes in this guide, Zanzibar biryani works for vegetarians, making it a good option if you would rather not eat meat.

blocks.orig: Finally, we have Mandazi. Mandazi is a sweet recipe that actually tastes a little like Vitumbua.
blocks.html: Last on the list is Mandazi, a sweet recipe whose taste is actually a little like Vitumbua.

blocks.orig: Just like Vitumbua, Mandazi is fairly similar to what we would consider to be donuts.
blocks.html: Like Vitumbua, Mandazi is quite close to what we would think of as doughnuts.

blocks.orig: So, if you weren’t too big a fan of Vitumbua, you should give Mandazi a try during your trip to Zanzibar.
blocks.html: So if Vitumbua was not really to your liking, try Mandazi on your trip to Zanzibar instead.

blocks.orig: In short, in this guide, we have taken a look at 10 luxury dishes that you have to try during your holiday to Zanzibar for a truly authentic experience.
blocks.html: To sum up, this guide has covered 10 luxury dishes you must taste on your Zanzibar holiday for a genuinely authentic experience.
